# a16z crypto

> A venture capital fund investing in blockchain, web3, and cryptocurrency startups, offering research, founder resources, and portfolio support.

a16z crypto is the cryptocurrency and web3 investment arm of Andreessen Horowitz, focused on funding and supporting early-stage blockchain companies. The site features investment insights, technical research, policy analysis, and founder resources across emerging crypto technologies and market trends.

## Key Topics

- blockchain
- web3
- venture capital
- DeFi
- stablecoins
- AI agents
- crypto
- Ethereum
- Bitcoin
- DAOs
- zero-knowledge proofs
- company building
- policy & regulation
- zkVM
- decentralization

## Fund & Portfolio

- [a16z crypto](https://a16zcrypto.com): a16z crypto venture capital fund investing in crypto and web3 startups
- [About a16z crypto](https://a16zcrypto.com/about): Overview of a16z crypto fund, mission, and web3 investment focus
- [Our Team](https://a16zcrypto.com/our-team): a16z crypto team directory with partners and leadership bios
- [Portfolio](https://a16zcrypto.com/portfolio): a16z crypto portfolio companies and featured blockchain investments

## Founder Resources & Programs

- [Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX)](https://a16zcrypto.com/accelerator): CSX accelerator program for early-stage crypto and blockchain companies
- [Company Building](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/focus-areas/company-building): Founder resources and startup guides for crypto entrepreneurship
- [Read Write Own](https://a16zcrypto.com/readwriteown): Read Write Own book by Chris Dixon on blockchain and web3 ownership
- [Portfolio Jobs](https://a16zcrypto.com/jobs): Job board for open roles across a16z crypto portfolio companies

## Research & Technical Analysis

- [Research](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/focus-areas/research): Blockchain research on consensus, security, and zero-knowledge proofs
- [Code & Engineering](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/focus-areas/code-engineering): Engineering content on zkVM, zero-knowledge proofs, and crypto research
- [Tech Trends](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/focus-areas/tech-trends): Focus area on emerging crypto tech trends and blockchain innovation
- [AI Needs Crypto — Especially Now](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/ai-needs-crypto-now): Article on AI-crypto integration and blockchain identity verification

## Market Analysis & Insights

- [All Content](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts): Content hub featuring crypto analysis, policy, and company building guides
- [State of Crypto 2025](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/state-of-crypto-report-2025): 2025 report on crypto maturation, stablecoins, and institutional adoption
- [Tourists in the Bazaar: B2B Payments & Stablecoins](https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/against-b2b-payments-stablecoins): Analysis of stablecoins for B2B payments and AI agent infrastructure
